note: Synthetic regression fixtures for the deterministic context guard. These do not prove live-model or cross-harness task quality.

cases.objective: Prepare a Meta campaign change brief without executing the change.
required_facts: Prepare a Meta campaign change brief
cases.source:
The campaign discussion has repeated the same background several times. The team wants a concise handoff for review, not a history lesson. Earlier exploratory notes about alternative headlines are no longer relevant to the immediate decision.

Target review is 26 September 2026 at 13:30 WIB. Budget ceiling Rp1.500.000 and the observed CTR reference is 3.7%. Source dashboard: https://example.com/campaign

Harus pertahankan budget ceiling persis.
Jangan execute atau publish sebelum approval owner.
Harus pisahkan observed platform signal dari causal conclusion.

The purpose of the packet is to let an approver understand the requested change, its spend boundary, and what evidence must be checked afterward. The repeated campaign narrative above can be removed from the dispatch layer as long as the exact decision constraints survive.

cases.objective: Prepare a reversible engineering handoff for the failing local service.
cases.source:
A local service has accumulated debugging notes from several attempts. Most of the notes repeat that the service should remain local-first and that previous guesses did not isolate the failure. Those repeated explanations are not required in the final dispatch card.

Current source of truth is D:\WORK\service\config.json. Health endpoint is http://127.0.0.1:4322. The current checkpoint date is 2026-09-29.

Harus buat perubahan sekecil dan reversible mungkin.
Jangan deploy ke production.
Jangan claim fixed sebelum negative test dan smoke test lulus.

The engineer needs the exact path, endpoint, restrictions, and verification rule. Historical speculation can stay in canonical notes rather than occupying the short dispatch context.

cases.objective: Compile the training revision into a short execution brief.
cases.source:
The proposal contains a long narrative about previous drafts, formatting preferences, and why the schedule was revised. The operational revision itself is much smaller than the surrounding explanation.

Training date is 14 Oktober 2026. Morning block starts 08:00 WIB and the practical demonstration starts 11:00 WIB. Session reference value Rp12.500.000.

Wajib pertahankan jam dan nominal apa adanya.
Jangan ubah practical demonstration menjadi full practical assessment.
Harus bedakan teori, demo, dan verification evidence.

The final worker only needs the revision facts, protected terminology, and acceptance boundary. Repeated proposal history belongs in the longer source layer.

cases.objective: Create a source-traceable research dispatch without flattening disagreement.
cases.source:
The research thread contains duplicated summaries from multiple turns. Some paragraphs repeat the same thesis with slightly different language. The dispatch layer should be smaller while leaving the detailed notes available on demand.

Primary source: https://example.com/source-a
Counter-source: https://example.org/source-b

Harus pertahankan kedua source pointer.
Jangan paksa dua sumber yang berbeda menjadi satu kesimpulan palsu.
Harus label uncertainty jika evidence belum cukup.

The researcher should preserve disagreement and use the canonical notes for detail. The short packet exists only to orient the next decision and should not become a substitute for the source material.

cases.objective: Prepare a compact document-processing handoff with exact source constraints.
cases.source:
A document-processing request includes many repetitions about keeping formatting clean, reducing token use, and making the next worker efficient. Those repetitions can be compacted if source fidelity remains visible.

Original file: D:\DOCS\proposal.pdf
Reference page: https://example.net/reference
Comparison threshold: 25%
Quoted project value: Rp2.200.000

Harus simpan source path dan reference URL.
Jangan hilangkan angka atau approval-related wording saat compaction.
Harus treat converted Markdown sebagai working representation, bukan original evidence.

The output should allow a downstream worker to know what to open and what must remain exact without loading all duplicated prose first.
